projects.name: River Bend campus
projects.quote: After the quarter, Hut 8 secured 592 acres of land for its River Bend campus, a project from this subset of its development pipeline.

projects.name: Vega
projects.quote: Secured Vega, a 205 MW behind-the-meter site in Texas, which is expected · to be energized in Q2 2025, less than one year after acquisition, through the Company’s greenfield development capabilities, which enables rapid deployment low-cost Bitcoin mining infrastructure.

projects.name: Salt Creek
projects.quote: Completed the greenfield development and energization of Salt Creek, a 63 · MW Bitcoin mining facility, just over three months after breaking ground for an all-in cost of approximately $240,000 per MW.
